document.abstract: One of the biggest concerns facing the media technology industry is that there won't be enough workers in the future. Engineers like Rachel Romero rebuke this fear, accomplishing great things while still in the early days of her career. This millennial powerhouse has made big waves in the industry and within SMPTE, working with the latest technology at some major organizations.
